findings.reading: A whole set (old tasks, finished applications) can be neither read nor hit; 'Sve 6' = 4 + 1 + 1 hints that something is missing and nothing says where. A person looking for an old task concludes it is gone.
findings.change: Tabs get the full row and Pretraga/Filteri move under it (uncommitted source ownTaskTabs.ts + MarketplacePresentation.tsx already does this for Moji zadaci and is not in the tested build); Moje prijave needs gap 20 to 12 and no fading edge so four tabs fit at 360 dp x 1.15. Add a render test at 360 dp x 1.15 for both screens.

findings.fact: t1_11 card 1 'Krečenje stana od 80 m² u belo' shows 'Tražim ponude' (green, price-tag glyph) where a status belongs, then 'Novi Sad', 'Fleksibilan termin' and '1/1', and no status word. t1_12 for the same task says '• Popunjen', then repeats 'Tražim ponude / Svako u prijavi predlaže ukupan iznos.' and never shows the agreed total, which t1_08 shows as 'Dogovoreno ukupno 62.000 RSD'.
findings.reading: The pricing mode sits in the status slot, so a task that already has its person reads as still collecting offers, and the agreed price is found only inside the Dogovor.
findings.change: State chip first on own cards from fields already loaded ('Dogovoreno 1 od 1', '1 prijava čeka izbor'); show the pricing mode only while offers are open; in Pregled replace the open-price block with the agreed total once the places are filled (read from the Dogovor, never invented).

findings.fact: Pinned green 'Pregledaj prijave →' (spoken: 'trenutno nema prijava za izbor, ukupno 1 prijava') sits under a row 'Prijave / Trenutno nema prijava za izbor. Ukupno 1 prijava' that has its own chevron: two controls to one place. Nothing on t1_12/t1_13 links to the Dogovor with the chosen person, while t1_08 links back to the task ('Otvori zadatak'). Code: the footer shows whenever the task has any application (NeedPresentation.tsx).
findings.reading: Breaks the owner's rule 'one primary action with the reason beside a grey one': the primary leads to a list with nothing to decide, while the real next step (talk, confirm completion) lives on another tab; links are one-way. What the list behind the button shows for an already chosen application, and the content of the '⋯' menu, were not captured.
findings.change: When nothing is selectable, footer = 'Otvori Dogovor' if the task read can carry the agreement id (else look it up in the Dogovori read the app already makes), otherwise a grey footer with the reason beside it. Row copy '1 prijava, izabrana' instead of 'Ukupno 1 prijava'; keep one of row or footer.

findings.fact: Početna: 'Čeka te 1' over two rows ('1 prijava ... Čeka tvoj izbor.' and 'Oceni završen Dogovor'). Moje prijave: orange 'Čeka te 4'. Bell on every root: '16 nepročitanih'. Moji zadaci: 'Aktivni 1' in a quiet pill next to '2 zadatka', while Početna says '2 aktivna · 1 nacrt' and the 'Nacrti' tab carries no count.
findings.reading: Each number is explainable (code: the rating row is 'never counted with them'; the Aktivni badge counts tasks waiting for my choice and is spoken as 'Za tvoj izbor' only to a screen reader) but a sighted person sees the same words with different numbers and cannot rank urgency; the orange 16 competes with the real group.
findings.change: Count what is drawn in the group (this reverses the HomePresentation comment, so show it to the owner) or draw the rating row outside it; draw the Aktivni badge in the attention tone and say it ('1 čeka izbor'); one definition of 'Čeka te' on Početna and Moje prijave; keep the bell as an inbox count and never in the 'waits' tone.
findings.wave: W4.1 + W8.1 (+ new: one definition of 'waits')

findings.fact: One job, five state words in five places: 'Tražim ponude' (Moji zadaci card, no status), '• Popunjen' (Pregled, under the title), '• Dogovoreno' (workspace heading), '• Izabrana' (Moje prijave, small label above the title), '• Završeno' / '• Otkazano' (Dogovori, fourth line). 'Test R18' is 'Završeno' in Dogovori > Istorija (t1_10) yet 'Izabrana' with 'Otvori Dogovor' in Moje prijave (t1_14).
findings.reading: The dot-plus-word pattern is shared, but name, size and position are not, so a person following one job from task to Dogovor to history cannot tell stages of one thing from different things.
findings.change: StatusChip (plan 5.1) in the same place on every card; one written glossary of stage words per object (task, application, agreement) and the rule that an application's status follows its Dogovor once one exists.

findings.fact: 'Termin nije potvrđen' is bold green with a green calendar on Početna and in the Dogovori list; in the workspace label and value repeat ('Termin' / 'Termin nije potvrđen', ink); task cards draw the same lack of a term in a grey calendar ('Fleksibilan termin', t1_11). The only control near it is 'Izmene i otkazivanje Dogovora – Cena, obim, termin ili otkazivanje uz razlog', third row after a scroll (t1_09).
findings.reading: Green reads 'in order'; the person cannot tell who has to act or how, and the only route to fix the term is named after cancelling.
findings.change: TermLine muted (not green) everywhere (plan 10.1); in the workspace the term row gets a quiet 'Dogovori termin' link into the existing Izmene screen with the term preselected; drop the repeated label.

findings.fact: Card 2 'Krečenje zida tehnikom Sahara (oko 15 m²)' carries '• 1 prijava čeka izbor ›' only as its footer strip (y 2276-2352 px, cut by the screen edge); card 1 above it needs nothing; the only other signal is the quiet pill 'Aktivni 1'.
findings.reading: The one action this screen exists for (choose a person) is its least visible object, and the card that needs the person is not first.
findings.change: State chip at the card's top in the attention tone ('Čeka te 1 prijava', plan 5.2); waiting tasks first only if the server order allows (the list is a server pager, no client re-sorting): ask the owner.

findings.fact: A Dogovor row = avatar + two-line title + name + role + status + date + place + price (about 240 dp, 300 with the rating strip: under two rows per screen). Roles read 'Traži pomoć' (row 1) and 'Uskače na tvoj zadatak' (row 2) while Početna says 'Tvoj zadatak' for the same Dogovor (code: Početna describes me, the list describes the other person). 'Završeno' sits in the tab 'Aktivni'. In Istorija two rows share title, person and time ('Pomoć pri nošenju ormara', 26. sep) and differ only by 'Završeno'/'Otkazano' and the price.
findings.reading: Seven lines to learn what happened, and the person must decode 'am I the helper or the requester?' from the other side's words.
findings.change: One AgreementRow: status chip first, time-first date, one function for the role in my terms, price at the right; Istorija leads with the outcome.

findings.fact: Four identical mascot discs, header '8 zadataka', the collapsed sheet shows exactly one card (about 250 dp, its foot touching the tab bar), a pin touches the zoom control, 'Novi Sad' is hidden under a pin, nothing links the shown card to a pin.
findings.reading: With U13 and U17 pins stay information-free, so the list must carry the choice; at this card height a person sees one task at a time, which is the 'preglednost' complaint in its purest form.
findings.change: Card to 190-210 dp (plan 5.2); strip tap opens the half stop with the map above and about 1.5 cards (U06); selected-pin linking, UI-only (7.2).

findings.fact: Pill 'Svi zadaci / Bilo kada · Dodaj uslo..' with sliders ('Uslovi pretrage') and '...' ('Još mogućnosti'); chips 'U blizini · Na daljinu · Na licu mest'; no profile, no bell (16 unread) and no 'Objavi zadatak' on this root, while Početna and Dogovori show profile + mark + bell.
findings.reading: The one chrome differs on the root where the person spends most time; publishing and the inbox need a blind tap into an icon menu, and the pill says nothing about active filters.
findings.change: Pill without controls, 'Filteri' as a captioned chip with a count, 'Objavi' visible, an orange dot on '...' while the inbox is non-empty (plan 6.1 + HP-07b).

findings.fact: Doors take y 128-328 dp of 808; 'Čeka te' starts at 378 dp; the 'Aktivni Dogovor' card starts at 676 dp, the tab bar at 714 dp (one title line visible); 'Moji zadaci' and 'Moje prijave' appear only after a scroll. The doors have no border or chevron, the Dogovor card has both.
findings.reading: A returning person sees actions first and their own situation second; the weakest-looking objects are the strongest actions. First-run and loading states were not captured.
findings.change: Bounded doors (photos per U02, FactArt fallback) and one bounded 'Čeka te' group with reserved skeleton height (plan 4.1); trim the door block so the Dogovor card starts above the fold.

findings.fact: The workspace header's right control is an outline bubble in a circle (spoken 'Poruke'), no tab, no word. Dogovori rows and the Početna card carry no unread mark; the only message cue is the inbox row 'Nova poruka / Imaš novu poruku u Dogovoru.' (t1_16).
findings.reading: The working channel of a Dogovor (agree a time, share a number) is the hardest thing to find on the screen made for it, and sits in the corner farthest from the thumb.
findings.change: Render the existing AgreementTabs 'Pregled | Poruke' under the person bar and remove the icon-only button (U11); add an unread dot to the Dogovori row only after verifying that inbox items carry the agreement id (plan 10.1 note).

findings.fact: 'Kontakt', 'Lokacija i pristup' and 'Tok Dogovora' have a down chevron (expand in place); 'Izmene i otkazivanje Dogovora' and 'Bezbednost i privatna prijava' have a right chevron (leave the screen); all five share sticker, bold title and grey subtitle, two with two-line titles; 'Prijavi problem' lies below the pinned footer.
findings.reading: A person cannot predict whether a tap opens in place or leaves; cancel and block carry the same weight as contact info; the screen is long for what it holds.
findings.change: Plan 10.2: 'Kontakt' and 'Lokacija' stay as the only disclosure rows; the other three move behind '...' (the owner's stalno/ponekad/retko rule).

findings.fact: 'Nova prijava / Imaš novu prijavu za Zadatak.' twice (29. and 28. sep), 'Nova poruka / Imaš novu poruku u Dogovoru.'; only the new-opportunity row leads with a task title (06:52 'Dostava punjača do Petrovaradina'). The capital 'Zadatak' reads like an unfilled template. InboxPresentation.tsx says an event carries no actor and no task title.
findings.reading: With two tasks the person must open every row to learn which one; 16 unread of this kind is what the bell number really holds.
findings.change: Server package 'obaveštenja sa imenom' (named in the code; needs the owner's exact PRIMENI). UI-only stopgaps that invent no subject: lowercase 'zadatak', group consecutive same-type rows ('Nova prijava x2').

findings.fact: The card says 'Jugovićevo → Petrovaradin'; the detail's first fact says 'Jugovićevo, Novi Sad' and 'Petrovaradin' appears only after a scroll under 'Od mesta do mesta', with the arrow dangling at the end of line one (t1_06). '0/1' stands next to a people glyph with no word; '2.000 RSD' is a bare number (spoken 'Budžet') while other screens say 'ukupno' or 'Tvoja ponuda'.
findings.reading: A delivery task loses its destination exactly where a worker decides; '0/1' and an unlabelled price are guesses.
findings.change: Top fact = the same two-place string as the card; capacity in words ('Traži 1 osobu', plan 9.3 words); the price gets its basis word or 'Cena nije navedena', never a bare amount.

findings.fact: 'prijava' is an application (Moje prijave, 'Nova prijava') and a report: in one workspace 'Bezbednost i privatna prijava / Blokiranje i poverljiva prijava podršci' and 'Prijavi problem' (one report is visible to the other side, one is confidential). Price words: 'Tražim ponude', 'Tvoja ponuda 100 RSD ukupno', 'Dogovoreno ukupno 62.000 RSD', bare '2.000 RSD'.
findings.reading: The collision sits on the safety path, where confusion costs most; a person may choose the visible report when they wanted the confidential one.
findings.change: Name the safety paths with another noun after the owner's wording check (copy only, no legal claim), keep 'prijava' for applications, one price glossary (plan X1).

findings.fact: Five phrasings for 'no exact time': 'Danas, fleksibilno', 'Fleksibilan termin', 'Fleksibilan raspon · Do 31. dec' (breaks as 'Do 31.' / 'dec'; t1_14 'Do 27.' / 'sep'), 'Bez tačnog termina', 'Termin nije potvrđen'.
findings.reading: One idea in five phrasings, one of them jargon ('raspon'); a date split over two lines reads like two facts.
findings.change: One phrase for flexible ('Bilo kada do 31. dec') and one for not agreed; non-breaking space between day and month in a view helper (plan 8.2).

findings.fact: First card about 383 dp with footer (about 1.5 cards per screen): '• Izabrana', two-line title, 'Na daljinu' (pin glyph), time (wraps), 'Tvoja ponuda 100 RSD ukupno', '1 osoba', a two-line quote of my own message ending '...', and only then 'Otvori Dogovor ›'.
findings.reading: For a chosen application the next step is the Dogovor; my own message and '1 osoba' are noise; the action is the last line of the tallest card in the app.
findings.change: State-first anatomy (plan 8.3): status chip, title, term, price, action; hide the quote once chosen; show the head count only above 1.

findings.fact: 'Milos SLJIVIC' over 'Uskače na tvoj zad..' (truncated with two dots) in both captures; the header is fixed, so it is cut at every scroll position.
findings.reading: The one line that says who this person is to me is cut at 360 dp x 1.15.
findings.change: One shorter string chosen once for list and header ('Uskače kod tebe') or two lines; part of the role-wording decision in plan 10.1.

findings.fact: The name line reads 'msljivic031' (the same account family shows as 'Milos' and 'Milos SLJIVIC' elsewhere); the row 'Ime na profilu' has no value; 'Dostupnost' and 'Kalendar obaveza' are two large tiles with no state text between full-width rows that have subtitles ('Profil je aktivan.', 'Novi Sad'); 'Kalendar obaveza' sits under 'Kako mogu da uskočim' although it is a schedule.
findings.reading: The name reads like a login; no client code derives names from an email, so check where sign-up gets it (test data?); tiles break the scan rhythm and promise nothing.
findings.change: Show the saved name or 'Dodaj ime', never a handle; give 'Ime na profilu' its value as subtitle; each tile one line of state from real data or turn them into rows; move 'Kalendar obaveza' out of the worker group.

findings.fact: Selected tab = pale grey capsule with green icon and label; inactive 'Zadaci' and 'Dogovori' icons are greyed stickers that read as disabled; labels are bold.
findings.reading: Where you are is still clear through the green label, so the owner's rule holds, but the capsule is faint and the inactive icons look switched off.
findings.change: Flat marks, quiet inactive tone and a top indicator (plan 2.1; uncommitted TabBarItem.tsx is in flight).

findings.fact: Wordless controls in prime positions: Dogovori calendar (spoken 'Kalendar obaveza'), workspace chat ('Poruke'), Zadaci sliders and '...' ('Uslovi pretrage', 'Još mogućnosti'), Moji zadaci search and filter circles ('Pretraga', 'Filteri'), detail '⋯' ('Više radnji').
findings.reading: Matches the owner's complaint that icons carry the text; people must guess.
findings.change: Captioned pill for every non-universal command (plan 2.3 ChromeIconButton caption).

findings.fact: The same task title is green on Zadaci, Moji zadaci and both details, ink on the Početna rows, Dogovori, Moje prijave and the inbox. 'Na daljinu' has a pin glyph in Moje prijave (t1_14) and a screen-like glyph in Dogovori (t1_10). The calendar is grey for a flexible term on task cards and green for 'Termin nije potvrđen' on Dogovor cards.
findings.reading: No written rule says what green means for a title; one fact gets two glyphs.
findings.change: Write the rule (green title = a task you can open, ink = an agreement or application) or unify; one glyph per fact; calendar tone follows UX-06.

findings.fact: The requester's rating is '4,7 (3)' with a star on the card, 'Traži pomoć · Ocena 4,7' without star or count on the detail, '5,0 · 4 ocene' on the profile; the profile star and the settings bell are orange.
findings.reading: One trust fact, three idioms; orange is used where nothing waits.
findings.change: One trust-line component (plan 9.1, ICO-11); orange only for what waits.

findings.fact: On details the attribution is three chips over two lines ('© OpenStreetMap', '© OpenMapTiles', 'OpenFreeMap'); on the Zadaci map it is one line with an info mark. The pin hides the city label ('Novi Sad' shows as 'ad'); the route shows one pin only.
findings.reading: The same legal element is drawn two ways and pushes the privacy line down.
findings.change: One attribution line with an info mark as a shared component; pin offset from labels.

findings.fact: Words: 'Lokacija i pristup / Precizni podaci samo uz dozvoljen pristup', 'Tok Dogovora / Sačuvani događaji', 'Od mesta do mesta', capital 'Zadatak' in inbox bodies, 'Kalendar obaveza', first-person 'Kako mogu da uskočim' in a 'ti' product.
findings.reading: Each is understandable, none is the plain word ('Tačna adresa', 'Istorija izmena', 'Relacija').
findings.change: Plain-word pass with the time and price glossary; privacy wording after the owner's check.

findings.fact: Moji zadaci has search and filter buttons for a list of two and no way to publish a task; Početna holds the only entry.
findings.reading: Controls for a long list on a short one; the natural next action after reading my tasks is missing.
findings.change: Show search and filter only above a size, add a quiet 'Objavi zadatak' in the header.

findings.fact: 'Aktivni 2' lists a Završeno Dogovor first while its rating is due.
findings.reading: A tab named active starts with a finished job.
findings.change: Rating-due Dogovori below the running ones or the tab named 'Otvoreni'.

findings.fact: Words repeat on one screen: 'Dogovoreno', 'Dogovoreni uslovi', 'Dogovoreno ukupno' and 'Termin / Termin nije potvrđen'.
findings.reading: The same stem three times in a row blurs which line is the state and which the money.
findings.change: 'Uslovi' and 'Ukupno'; term row shows only the value.

findings.fact: The two rows of 'Čeka te' differ in anatomy: row 1 names what waits in grey ('Čeka tvoj izbor.'), row 2 is a verb-first command ('Oceni završen Dogovor').
findings.reading: The same group says 'what' once and 'do what' once.
findings.change: Verb first on both ('Izaberi izvođača'), the reason second.

constraints: Nothing is applied to DEV or PROD; no server, Edge or certificate change from a UI wave; no new npm package; no paid call; no new account or key.

B22 motion constraint: no new Reanimated layout, entering or exiting animations; new motion uses RN Animated with the native driver or View transform/opacity; avoid animated SVG draws; keep list rows mounted; Reduce Motion honoured.
LOCKED, never edit: src/ui/entry/**, src/ui/referenceEntry/**, EntryWelcome, the mascot and HOME signature and the original assets.

Copy and look: 'ti' voice without grammatical gender, no 'server' wording, one vreme() time format, no eyebrow or orientation copy, text never below 12 px at ordinary size, the primary action green with a white label, orange only for what waits, white reading surfaces, no invented data (a missing price never looks like an amount), no category shown to people; legal and privacy wording needs the owner.

Process: test-first; run only the relevant files with npx jest <paths> and finish with npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json; screen suites crash if a screen transitively imports supabaseClient (copy the mocking pattern of the neighbouring tests); the one-token-source ratchets in src/ui/system/__tests__ are tight both ways; one writer per file; do not edit package.json, patches/**, .github/**, docs/control/**, AGENTS.md.

Verify on the Android emulator at 360 dp wide, font scale 1.15 (the HONOR phone is the owner's: never touch it) and re-capture the same 16 screens as the AFTER; judge layout and content, ignore software-GL jank.
forCodex.inFlight: Uncommitted work by other agents in the same checkout (one writer per file; check git status before touching): src/ui/v2/ownTaskTabs.ts, src/ui/v2/MarketplacePresentation.tsx and src/data/__tests__/moji-zadaci-tabrow.test.tsx (plan 8.1, Moji zadaci tabs); src/ui/system/TabBarItem.tsx, Glyph.tsx, src/app/(app)/_layout.tsx, ScreenChrome.tsx, ScreenHeader.tsx (plan 2.1 and 2.3).
forCodex.outsideTheWave: UX-14 (inbox rows with a subject) needs the server package 'obaveštenja sa imenom' and the owner's exact PRIMENI; UX-16 safety wording needs the owner's wording check (no legal claim); UX-04 reverses a code comment ('never counted with them') so the owner should see it; the waiting-first order in UX-07 is a server-order question for the owner.

patterns: Screen ids in findings are the t1_NN prefix of the file names; dp = px / 3 at 360 dp, font 1.15; sizes come from uiautomator bounds, 'spoken' marks accessibility text that is not visible.

DENSITY: the same unit costs very different space (inbox row about 100 dp, task card about 250-330, Dogovor row 240-300, application card 383): one to two objects per screen on every list, so the missing overview is a card-anatomy problem before it is a visual one (plan 5.2, 8.3, 10.1).

STATE IS THE QUIET, LAST OR MISSING ELEMENT (none on Moji zadaci cards, a small label on Moje prijave, line four on Dogovori, a dot line on Pregled, a heading in the workspace) and its words differ per list (UX-02, UX-05, UX-07).

ONE WORD, MANY MEANINGS: 'Čeka te' (1 / 4 / 16), 'Aktivni' (holds a finished Dogovor; the Moji zadaci badge counts waiting tasks), 'prijava' (application and report), 'Termin' (label and value), 'Dogovoreno' three times on one screen.

ONE-WAY LINKS: Dogovor to task exists ('Otvori zadatak'), task to Dogovor does not; inbox rows carry no subject; Dogovori rows show no unread cue; a job cannot be followed through its life by tapping.

COLOUR CARRIES MEANING IT SHOULD NOT: green = action, money, selection and an unconfirmed term; orange = what waits but also the bell badge, the profile rating star and the settings bell; title colour has no written rule.

CLIPPING AT THE OWNER'S GEOMETRY: tab labels ('Is', 'Završene'), header role line ('zad..'), search pill ('uslo..'), chips ('mest'), dates split over two lines ('Do 31.' / 'dec'). Layouts were tuned for 380 dp and up; 360 dp x 1.15 is the real case, so make it a render gate for every list and header test and for the emulator tour.

NO EYEBROW OR ORIENTATION COPY appears on any of the 16 screens (explanatory lines state a rule or a consequence); the owner's rule holds and the problem is information scent and state, not missing orientation text.

DECISIONS U01-U19, VISIBLE AND HOLDING: U03 (price-tag glyph on prijave and ponude, bubble+check Dogovori tab), U13 and U17 (no photo on cards, plain logo-disc pins), U15 (Dogovor is a white reading surface), U07 partly (map palette unchanged).

DECISIONS NOT YET VISIBLE (planned wave): U01 partly (marks at 24 px and below are flat single-green, 28-32 px icons are still stickers; W1.3/W2.3), U02 (doors are unbounded art, no photos; W4.1), U04 (floating pill bar remains; W6.4), U11 (chat is an icon; W10.2), U16 (all segments are underline tabs; W8.1), U18 (tab icons are stickers, greyed when inactive; W2.1 in flight), U07 stronger control edges (W6.1).

DECISIONS AT RISK OR VIOLATED: U14 (ink titles on Dogovor, application and Početna rows beside green task titles: write the rule or unify), U01 (orange on things that do not wait: profile rating star, settings bell, bell badge 16).
DECISIONS NOT TESTABLE IN STILLS: U05, U06, U08, U09, U10, U12, U19.
CAPTURE QUALITY: t1_04 duplicates t1_05; every list is short test data (2 tasks, 2-4 agreements, 6 applications, 16 notifications), so long lists, empty and first-run states are unseen.
